findings: Use one canonical plugin and one portable Linux tooling recipe with thin harness variants; a declarative sbx environment supplies install-once/attach/resume UX on supported hosts. Full portability is a tested support matrix, not an unconditional promise. Mount a self-contained clone for live editing; linked worktree alone lacks guest Git metadata.
